diffs.diff: chip ID register 0xfa: part 106, datasheet reading 57962
diffs.evidence: Pimoroni's IO Expander register map defines 'CHIP_ID = 0xE26A' as a 16-bit value split across 'REG_CHIP_ID_L = 0xFA' and 'REG_CHIP_ID_H = 0xFB', and get_chip_id() combines them as 'return list(msg_r)[0] | (list(msg_r)[1] << 8)', so register 0xFA alone holds the low byte 0x6A = 106 (0xFB holds 0xE2 = 226); the second reading assigned the whole 16-bit ID 0xE26A = 57962 to the single 8-bit register 0xFA.
